spans.s:
हण्डा f. (-ण्डा) A large earthen pot. Ind. An interjection of calling to
a low female: see हण्डे.
हण्डिका f. (-का) A earthen pot or boiler; also हण्डी and हण्डा ।

हण्डिकासुत m. (-तः) A small earthen pot.
 E. हण्डिका, सुत son.

हण्डे Ind. A vocative particle to be addressed in theatrical language
to a female of inferior rank.
 E. हिडि to treat with contempt or
disrespect, aff. ए, and the form irr.; also with आ aff., हण्डा.
